intro: The Filled Brown Waterskin contains fresh water drawn from a rare pond near Brine's hut in the Barrens. Collected by aspiring shaman, it forms the first fundamental step in brewing the sapta needed to commune with the spirits of water.

p: In the parched expanse of the Barrens, surface water is both a blessing and a battleground. The pond nestled beneath Brine's hut offers precious hydration that draws the desperate and defensive quilboar who dwell nearby. For an initiate walking the path of the shaman, filling this simple leather waterskin is not merely an errand of gathering supplies; it is an elemental lesson. By approaching the pool and witnessing the fierce territorial struggle surrounding it, the novice observes firsthand how the very substance that sustains life in the desert can drive mortal creatures to violence.
